Services: sales, leasing, property management, investment consultation, off-plan launches.
Fees (published on https://www.rfrrealestate.com/services): property management from 5% of annual rent; sales 2%; leasing 5%; plus VAT.

## 2. Ras Al Khaimah and the four areas

Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) is one of the seven emirates of the United Arab Emirates. Foreigners can buy freehold in the Emirate's designated freehold areas, which Ras Al Khaimah Municipality lists as Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. UAE and GCC nationals can buy anywhere in the Emirate.

Al Marjan Island — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-marjan-island
Four man-made, coral-shaped islands off the Al Hamra coast. Most of RAK's branded residences are being built here (including Address, Nobu, JW Marriott, Nikki Beach and W), and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort is scheduled to open in 2027. Indicative ranges from RFR listings and public launch data: studios from about AED 920K; one- and two-bedroom branded residences about AED 1.7–3.5M; one-bedroom rents about AED 65–90K a year; two-bedroom about AED 75–130K a year; about 6–8% gross yield.

Mina Al Arab — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/mina-al-arab
A low-rise waterfront community built around lagoons and protected mangroves, anchored by the Anantara and InterContinental resorts. Villas, townhouses and lagoon-front apartments. Indicative: apartments from about AED 800K, villas about AED 2.5–6M, about 5.5–7% gross yield.

Al Hamra Village — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-hamra-village
The Emirate's original master community: an 18-hole championship golf course, a marina and yacht club, the Waldorf Astoria and a mall. Falcon Island, a private villa enclave, sits within it. The deepest rental market in RAK. Indicative: apartments from about AED 500K, townhouses and villas about AED 1.5–5M, about 7–8.5% gross yield.

Downtown RAK — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/downtown-rak
The working city: Al Nakheel, Julphar and the corniche, with hospitals, offices and government. Towers and mid-rise apartments. Indicative: apartments from about AED 400K, the highest yields of the four at about 7–9% gross. Freehold is limited to designated projects such as Julphar Towers and RAK Central.

All area ranges are indicative, based on RFR listings and public launch data. Exact figures for a unit are available on request.


## 3. Listings and off-plan approach

Listings: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/listings/
RFR lists homes for sale and rent across the four areas, plus off-plan units. Each listing has its own page (for example furnished rentals on Al Marjan Island and in Al Hamra Village, a villa in Al Juwais, a plot in Mina Al Arab).

Off-plan launches: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/
RFR's current book has 9 launches on Al Marjan Island, with developer entry prices from AED 0.92M to AED 4.06M and payment plans from 50/50 to 80/20. Handover dates in the book run from Q4 2026 to Q4 2028. Launches: Address Residences (Emaar), Nobu Residences (H&H Development), JW Marriott Residences (WOW Resorts), Nikki Beach Residences (Aldar), W Hotel & Residences (Dalands), Costa Mare (Ellington), Manta Bay (Major Developers), Sora Beach Residences (AARK), Masa Residence (Durar Group). These are RFR book figures, not official market statistics.

Market note (September 2026): https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
RFR's commentary on what the Wynn opening means for Al Marjan Island. It is indicative commentary based on RFR's book and announced launches, not financial advice.

### 4.1 Buying property in Ras Al Khaimah (2026 guide)
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/buying-property-in-ras-al-khaimah
Updated 15 November 2026.
- Who can buy: foreigners in designated freehold areas; UAE and GCC nationals anywhere.
- Government fees (Ras Al Khaimah Municipality, Lands & Properties Sector): buyer registration fee 2% of market value; seller a further 2%; AED 200 plan issuance; AED 200 title deed issuance; mortgage registration 0.1% of the loan. Example: AED 1,000,000 apartment, no mortgage = AED 20,400 buyer government fees.
- Resale documents: Emirates ID or passport, developer NOC (freehold areas), seller's original title deed, power of attorney if an agent acts.
- Off-plan: sign the developer's SPA and pay against its schedule.
- No income tax or capital gains tax on property in the UAE.
- Seven steps: budget and goal; shortlist an area; view (in person or video); reserve and sign (MOU or SPA); developer NOC; transfer and register at RAK Municipality; handover or let.

### 4.2 Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah: a 2026 guide
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-marjan-island
Published 15 November 2026.
- What it is: four man-made, coral-shaped islands off the Al Hamra coast; a designated freehold area.
- Homes: mostly off-plan branded residences with a hotel component; also completed buildings with homes to rent and resell.
- Wynn Al Marjan Island: an integrated resort; joint venture reported as Wynn Resorts, Marjan and RAK Hospitality Holding; opening target September 2027 (Gulf News, Khaleej Times).
- Published data (shown separately, different methods):
  - CBRE, Ras Al Khaimah Real Estate Market Review H1 2026 (published 21 September 2026): Al Marjan Island apartment values +23.1% year on year; Al Hamra +14.7%; emirate apartment sales values about +18.0% to AED 2,298 per sq. ft.; villas +7.3%; apartment rents +14.3%, led by Mina Al Arab and Al Marjan Island; pricing and absorption moderated after the end of February 2026.
  - ValuStrat Price Index Q2 2026 (reported 4 August 2026): first quarterly decline in more than two years; overall index 123.5 points (−0.5% quarter on quarter, +5.4% year on year; base 100 = Q1 2024); Al Marjan Island apartments +9.4% a year, AED 928,000 per unit or AED 1,160 per sq. ft., unchanged on the quarter; average gross yields 5.3% for freehold apartments and villas.
  - Supply (CBRE): more than 34,000 residential units expected in RAK between 2026 and 2030, around 10,000 branded.
- None of these figures is a forecast.

### 4.3 Wynn Al Marjan and RAK property prices (2026)
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/wynn-al-marjan-effect-on-property-prices
Published 15 November 2026.
- Announced: integrated resort on Al Marjan Island; opening target September 2027; budget reported raised by about USD 600 million to around USD 5.7 billion (coverage of Wynn Resorts' August 2026 earnings). CBRE's H1 2026 review (21 September 2026) still cited USD 5.1 billion. No verified room count is quoted.
- Data so far: the CBRE and ValuStrat figures above; both show year-on-year growth, strongest for Al Marjan apartments, and both show slowing during 2026.
- Unknown: prices after opening; whether the date holds; how much rental demand the resort creates; other drivers such as rates and wider UAE supply.
- Supply: 34,000+ units 2026–2030 can move prices and rents either way.
- Questions to ask before buying: handover date versus September 2027 and what the SPA says if it slips; payment plan; service charge in writing; evidence of rental demand from completed buildings; competing handovers in the same quarter; total costs including the 2% registration fee.
- The guide makes no prediction that prices will rise because Wynn opens.

### 4.4 Golden Visa via Ras Al Khaimah property (2026 guide)
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/golden-visa-ras-al-khaimah-property
Published 15 November 2026. Official pages checked 15 November 2026.
- Threshold: one or more properties in the UAE with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000, in full ownership in the investor's name (ICP, page last updated 10 September 2026). RAKEZ: minimum AED 2 million, off-plan or completed; multiple properties under the applicant's name accepted.
- Off-plan: ICP — units totalling at least AED 2,000,000 from an approved local real estate company authorised by the competent local authority. RAKEZ — developer letter confirming value, and SPA signed and stamped by the developer.
- Mortgage: ICP — financing through a loan is allowed if from an approved local bank.
- RAKEZ documents: passport valid at least six months; photo; valid health insurance from the immigration-approved list; Real Estate Valuation Certificate from the Real Estate Registration Department addressed to Ras Al Khaimah ICP; off-plan documents as above. The applicant must be inside the UAE when submitting the request.
- Health insurance: ICP — investor and family must hold comprehensive, valid health insurance throughout the residency.
- Term: official pages differ. ICP and RAKEZ say 10 years for real estate investors; the u.ae portal's eligibility table (28 July 2026) lists 5 years for real estate investments (10 years for public investments). Get written confirmation from ICP or the Ras Al Khaimah channel at the time of application.
- RFR's role: helps people buy property in Ras Al Khaimah. RFR is not an immigration lawyer or consultant, does not issue visas, does not submit applications and cannot guarantee approval.

### 4.5 Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah: a 2026 guide
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/mina-al-arab
Published 15 November 2026. Facts as on the Mina Al Arab area page (https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/mina-al-arab); fees reused from the buying guide.
- What it is: a low-rise waterfront community built around lagoons and protected mangroves, anchored by the Anantara and InterContinental resorts. Villas, townhouses and lagoon-front apartments in an established, family-led neighbourhood. A designated freehold area.
- Indicative ranges (RFR listings and public launch data): apartments from about AED 800K; villas about AED 2.5–6M; 3-bed villa rent about AED 85–140K a year; 2-bed apartment about AED 60–95K a year; about 5.5–7% gross yield. Exact figures for any unit on request.
- Who lives here: families relocating to RAK, long-term residents, and buyers who want water without the resort crowds.
- On the doorstep: Anantara Mina Al Arab; InterContinental Mina Al Arab; mangrove beach and boardwalks; RAK Academy about 10 min; RAK city centre about 15 min; RAK Airport about 30 min.
- RFR advisory note: The Ritz-Carlton Residences and Porto Playa are the next phase, the first branded product on this side of the coast. The guide quotes no prices or dates for that phase.

### 4.6 Al Hamra Village, Ras Al Khaimah: a 2026 guide
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-hamra-village
Published 15 November 2026. Facts as on the Al Hamra Village area page (https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-hamra-village); fees reused from the buying guide.
- What it is: the Emirate's original master community: an 18-hole championship golf course, a marina and yacht club, the Waldorf Astoria, a mall and a decade of tenants. Falcon Island, its private villa enclave, sits within it. A designated freehold area.
- Indicative ranges (RFR listings and public launch data): apartments from about AED 500K; townhouses and villas about AED 1.5–5M; 1-bed rent about AED 45–65K a year; 3-bed villa about AED 110–160K a year; about 7–8.5% gross yield. Exact figures for any unit on request.
- Who lives here: families, golfers, Al Hamra and Wynn workforce, and investors who want tenants in place from day one.
- On the doorstep: Al Hamra Golf Club; Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club; Al Hamra Mall; Waldorf Astoria RAK; Falcon Island; Dubai (DXB) about 50 min.
- RFR advisory note: the closest established community to Al Marjan Island, so it is where the resort staff arriving in 2027 will rent. This is RFR's view, not a forecast of rents or prices.

### 4.7 Off-plan payment plans in Ras Al Khaimah (2026)
https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/off-plan-payment-plans-ras-al-khaimah
Published 15 November 2026. Uses only figures already on the off-plan page, the nine launch pages and the buying guide.
- Off-plan means signing for a home before it's finished; you decide from renders, floor plans, virtual tours and a site visit, and you pay in instalments as it's built. Check the developer's track record, the payment plan and the exact plot before you sign.
- Plans in RFR's book run from 50/50 to 80/20, so part of the price is paid during construction and the balance typically on handover. The instalment schedule is set in each developer's SPA; the site publishes no month-by-month schedules.
- Launches as published (starting price, plan, handover): Address Residences AED 2,400,000, 80/20, Q1 2028; Costa Mare AED 2,100,000, 70/30, Q3 2028; JW Marriott Residences AED 2,950,000, 60/40, Q4 2027; Manta Bay AED 1,200,000, 50/50, Q4 2026; Masa Residence AED 920,000, 60/40, Q4 2026; Nikki Beach Residences AED 1,750,000, 60/40, Q4 2028; Nobu Residences AED 2,100,000, 60/40, Q1 2028; Sora Beach Residences AED 2,800,000, 60/40, Q4 2026; W Hotel & Residences AED 4,060,000, 50/50, Dec 2027.
- Starting prices: floor, view and the payment plan change the figure. Ask RFR what is still available before reserving.


## 5. Common questions and the page that answers them

- Can I buy property in Ras Al Khaimah as a foreigner? Answer: Yes, in the designated freehold areas. Ras Al Khaimah Municipality lists them as Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. The buyer pays a registration fee of 2% of the market value, plus AED 200 for plan issuance and AED 200 for the title deed. You do not necessarily need to be in the UAE: RFR runs video viewings for overseas buyers, and a power of attorney can be used at the transfer. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/buying-property-in-ras-al-khaimah
- How do off-plan payment plans work in Ras Al Khaimah? Answer: Off-plan means signing for a home before it is finished. Plans run from 50/50 to 80/20 across the 9 Al Marjan launches in RFR's current book, with entry prices from AED 920K to AED 4.06M and published handover dates from Q4 2026 to Q4 2028. These are starting prices; the floor, view and payment plan change the final figure. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/off-plan-payment-plans-ras-al-khaimah
- Can I get a UAE Golden Visa by buying property in Ras Al Khaimah? Answer: Official sources set the minimum at property worth AED 2 million in total, owned in your name; off-plan counts according to ICP and RAKEZ, and more than one property can be combined. Official sources differ on whether the term is 5 or 10 years. RFR does not issue visas or give immigration advice. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/golden-visa-ras-al-khaimah-property
- Will Wynn Al Marjan Island raise property prices? Answer: Nobody can promise that. The resort is scheduled to open in September 2027, as reported. Published data show values rose year on year in 2026, fastest for Al Marjan Island apartments, but growth slowed during the year, there is no data yet on prices after the resort opens, and more than 34,000 new units are expected across the Emirate by 2030. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/wynn-al-marjan-effect-on-property-prices
- Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village or Al Marjan Island: which area suits me? Answer: Mina Al Arab is a low-rise, family-led lagoon and mangrove community (about 5.5–7% gross, indicative). Al Hamra Village is the original master community with golf, a marina and the deepest rental market in RAK (about 7–8.5% gross, indicative), and the closest established community to Al Marjan Island. Al Marjan Island is where most of RAK's branded residences are being built and where Wynn is due to open; developer entry prices in RFR's book run from AED 0.92M to AED 4.06M. Compare all four areas at https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/mina-al-arab, https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-hamra-village and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/guides/al-marjan-island
- Who is RFR Real Estate, which areas does it cover and how do I start? Answer: RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC, a licensed brokerage that works only in Ras Al Khaimah (Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village, Downtown RAK); not RFR Holding of New York. Call, WhatsApp or email to start; it is free and there is no commitment. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ (Quick answers) and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about

## 7. Editorial policy

https://www.rfrrealestate.com/editorial-policy
- Publisher: the site is published by RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC ("RFR Real Estate"), a licensed brokerage and advisory firm in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, working only in Ras Al Khaimah. Not RFR Holding of New York.
- Guides: informational pages about buying property, the four areas, off-plan launches and the Golden Visa property route in Ras Al Khaimah, written by the RFR advisory team and dated when published or updated. General information only. RFR is a brokerage, so it has a commercial interest in the market it writes about.
- Sources: guides name official or published sources and give the date each was checked.
- Disagreements: where official sources differ, the site reports what each says rather than choosing. Example: on the property Golden Visa term, ICP and RAKEZ say 10 years and the u.ae eligibility table says 5 years (checked 15 November 2026); the site does not say which applies.
- Not published: invented reviews or testimonials, star ratings or review scores, rating markup, the trade licence number (available on request) or a street address.
- Corrections: +971 58 501 5885, WhatsApp https://wa.me/971585015885, info@rfrrealestate.com.


## 8. Disclaimer

General information only. Not legal, financial, tax or immigration advice. Rules, fees and figures change; confirm with the official authority (for visas, ICP or the relevant Ras Al Khaimah channel such as RAKEZ) before acting. Past price changes are not a forecast. RFR does not promise yields, price rises or visa outcomes.
